messages.subject: weighted wlsmv
parts:
Hi there,

is there a way yet to incorporate sampling weights in WLSMV estimation? As far as i know, lavaan.survey doesn't support WLSMV yet. A reviewer suggested to simply use a weighted polychoric correlation matrix as input for the cfa, but then i would need to pass the weight matrix also; unfortunately, i have no clue how to calculate that matrix. I guess it would be necessary to account sampling weights there as well? Furthermore, i wouldn't be sure whether this would be an appropriate approach.

best,
felix

parts: so, would it be feasible to use a polychoric correlation matrix with the DWLS matrix obtained with the unweighted data?

I have also been looking to add survey weights, so that would be awesome

I think gsem in Stata 15 now does multiple group categorical CFA with survey data.
https://www.stata.com/manuals/sem.pdf 

In the manual's section on categorical data, it just says this
Survey data gsem with categorical latent variables also supports estimation with survey data; however, only the linearized variance estimator is supported.

At page 556 (for survey continuous data) it cites only Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal's 2006 book

G
